facts.business: Sudeep Pharma Limited manufactures mineral-based ingredients for pharmaceutical, food, and nutrition sectors, and has extended into battery materials including battery-grade iron phosphate for LFP batteries through its subsidiary Sudeep Advanced Materials.

facts.related_party_note: The Company's international transactions with associated enterprises are at arm's length as per independent accountant's report for year ended 31st March 2025. Management believes transactions post 31st March 2025 continue to be at arm's length. Holding company advanced loan of Rs 13,730.86 lakhs to subsidiary Sudeep Pharma B.V. in May 2025, which invested Rs 12,857.63 lakhs in step-down subsidiary Nutrition Supplies and Services (Ireland) Limited.
